import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    dtype = getattr(torch, ctx['input__dtype'])
    shape = ctx['input__shape']
    c = shape[1]
    input_t = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    weight = torch.randn(c, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    bias = torch.randn(c, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    running_mean = torch.randn(c, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    running_var = torch.rand(c, dtype=dtype, device=device) + 0.5
    return {
        'input': input_t,
        'weight': weight,
        'bias': bias,
        'running_mean': running_mean,
        'running_var': running_var,
        'momentum': 0.1,
        'eps': 1e-5,
    }


def run(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps):
    return torch.ops.aten._native_batch_norm_legit_no_training(
        input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps
    )
